confidence: high for repeat-withdraw behavior; medium for exact source-level state variable names
validated_claims: The legacy locker ownership was transferred to the attacker-controlled handoff wallet in the related setup transaction.
The primary alert transaction prepared one LP market by swapping BNB into GWC and minting a small LP amount to the attacker.
Subsequent transactions repeatedly called unlockToken(uint256) for the same lock index and received a fresh LP transfer each time.
The measured window contains 667,465 attacker-directed unlock events across 1,362 transactions and 45 LP token contracts.
warnings: The vulnerable locker source is unverified; code is reconstructed from bytecode selectors, trace behavior, storage behavior, and revert strings.
The externally reported $7.3M impact was not independently repriced for every LP reserve in this run.
The primary PeckShield-image transaction is a market-preparation transaction for one target LP, not the first repeat-unlock withdrawal transaction.
